title: Fix putting anything in a fish gene gun
author: lelandkemble

changes.text: You can no longer put everything other than a fish gene into a fish gene gun

title: Completely refactors HUD element management and datumizes inventory HUDs
author: SmArtKar

changes.text: Non-aliens with an implanted plasma vessel now see their plasma level in their HUD instead of just the stat panel
Refactored the entirety of HUD management code, report if anything breaks!

title: Hydroponics tray autogrow power use becomes more efficient with parts
author: Hatterhat

changes.text: Upgraded hydroponics trays now have reduced power draw with improved parts, in the wake of complaints from both engineering and botanical staff regarding exponentially increased short circuit frequency (and associated energy waste) in affected tray basins.

title: Fixes wizard, cult, nukies, revs, and malf from unable to be be rolled roundstart
author: MrMelbert

changes.text: Fixes wizard, cult, nukies, revs, and malf being unable to be selected for roundstart antag (yes, you read that right)

title: [NO GBP] Fixes FOV blocker harddels
author: SmArtKar

changes.text: FOV blockers no longer harddel

title: fix ascended void heretic deflection sounds
author: Absolucy

changes.text: Ascended Void heretics now properly play the deflect sound when deflecting projectiles.

title: Fixes combat indicator disappearing
author: JohnFulpWillard

changes.text: The Combat indicator will now properly move back to its original location when using F12.
Sleep icon now appears again & rest icon now respects "Toggle Hotkeys button" mode.

title: Disjointed eyes such as AI eyes, advanced camera consoles, & looking up properly show HUDs
author: lelandkemble

changes.text: HUDs are now visible when looking up a floor, as well as by AIS and camera consoles on lower floors.

title: Slot Machine DLC - Diversified Debt for Every Department
author: timothymtorres

changes.text: To help cover budget expenses, NT has redesigned and installed new slot machines that are themed by department. Slot machines can also be linked to bank accounts via ID cards or department budget cards. NT takes a 40% cut of profit to payout major jackpots and bonus spins. Please gamble responsibly.
Replaced all slot machines with slot machine random spawners. Added syndicate slot machines to Syndicate bases and nuke outposts.

title: read-only alist support for VV
author: Absolucy

changes.text: View Variables can now properly view alists, altho it cannot edit them.

title: Walking in snow leaves snowprints, snowstorms clear them
author: MrMelbert

changes.text: Walking in snow or sand leaves behind prints. You can examine the turf to see what left the prints, like with bloodprints.
Snowstorms or sandstorms clear away any footprints left behind in the snow or sand.
Some equipment or effects, like skis or snowshoes, prevent you from leaving prints in the snow.
You can fill in snowprints with snow.

title: Pneumatic Cannons can now be placed on tables and some cleanup/QOL.
author: ArcaneMusic

changes.text: The pneumatic cannon's examine will now show the contents of the cannon loaded.
You may now place a pneumatic cannon (and the clown's pie cannon!) onto tables.

title: Fixes three cult runtimes
author: lelandkemble

changes.text: Three cult abilities no longer runtime

title: Wheelys dont turn you when you kick them out
author: lelandkemble

changes.text: Wheelys dont turn you when you kick them out

title: Recovered crew/Thanatorenasia bodies are shown as "revivable" when orbited in a morgue tray (+makes it shake)
author: MrMelbert

changes.text: Recovered crew/Thanatorenasia bodies in morgue trays change the indicator to green when a ghost is orbiting them (to allow ghosts to signal they want it to be revived)
Recovered crew/Thanatorenasia bodies now cause morgue trays / bodybags to shake when orbited, much like how the body itself shakes when orbited (to allow ghosts to signal they want it to be revived)

title: fixes cyborg defib refunding
author: TheRyeGuyWhoWillNowDie

changes.text: using a dedicated cyborg defib upgrade on a mediborg with a backpack defib installed will properly eject it

title: Revamps food menu sorting
author: MrMelbert

changes.text: "Egg" foodtype now exists for better food sorting, though no species in particular likes or dislikes it at the moment.

Food crafting recipes now have three sub categories - Cuisine type, Dish type, and Meal type. You can now filter between "Moth Pizzas" or "Lizard Soups" rather than needing to guess if the recipe is in "Pizza" or "Mothic".
de-capitalized several foods

title: Chemical implants can be synced with a remote signalling device(and also work at all)
author: lelandkemble

changes.text: Remote chemical implants can be synced with a remote signalling device to activate without a Prisoner Management Console.

title: Randomize tts voice more appropriately
author: MrMelbert

changes.text: TTS voice is more appropriately randomized to gender
Getting randomized through means such as mulligan toxin randomizes TTS voices
